name: Killer Whale
traits: Tyler Kamstra, Monstrous Races v2, p. 251. Player traits for 2014 fifth edition.
Killer Whale, also called orca. Medium Beast with +2 Strength. Typical alignment is neutral.
Swim 50 ft., with no walking movement. Hold breath for up to 30 minutes. Blindsight reaches 60 ft. and becomes unavailable while deafened.
Bite with an unarmed strike for 1d8 slashing plus Strength modifier. Cannot wield weapons, use shields, or manipulate items such as tools, foci, or wands.
Speaks, reads, and writes Common.

name: Lion
traits: Tyler Kamstra, Monstrous Races v2, p. 251. Player traits for 2014 fifth edition.
Lions are Medium Beasts with +1 Strength and a 50-ft. walking speed. Typical alignment is neutral.

Bite or claw with an unarmed strike for 1d8 piercing or slashing plus Strength modifier. Checks using smell for Perception have advantage. With a 10-ft. run-up, long jump up to 25 ft. Cannot wield weapons, use shields, or manipulate items such as tools, foci, or wands.
Pack Tactics takes a bonus action. The next attack roll you make that turn against a creature has advantage if a non-incapacitated ally is within 5 ft. of the target.
If you go at least 15 ft. straight toward a creature and land an unarmed strike on it that turn, Pounce lets you try to shove it prone as a bonus action.
Speaks, reads, and writes Common.

name: Mastiff
traits: Tyler Kamstra, Monstrous Races v2, p. 253. Player traits for 2014 fifth edition.
Mastiffs are Medium Beasts with +1 each to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution. Walk 40 ft. Typical alignment is neutral.
Bite using an unarmed strike for 1d8 piercing plus Strength modifier. Perception checks using hearing or smell have advantage.
Cannot wield weapons, use shields, or manipulate items such as tools, foci, or wands.
Speaks, reads, and writes Common.

name: Mule
traits: Tyler Kamstra, Monstrous Races v2, p. 253. Player traits for 2014 fifth edition.
Mules are Medium Beasts with +2 Strength and +2 Constitution. Walk 40 ft. Typical alignment is neutral.
Count as one size larger for carrying capacity and for pushing, dragging, or lifting. Strength and Dexterity checks and saves against effects that would knock you prone have advantage.
Hooves are unarmed strikes for 1d8 bludgeoning plus Strength modifier. Cannot wield weapons, use shields, or manipulate items such as tools, foci, or wands.
Speaks, reads, and writes Common.

name: Octopus
traits: Tyler Kamstra, Monstrous Races v2, p. 254. Player traits for 2014 fifth edition.
Octopuses, also called octopi, are Medium Beasts with +2 Dexterity. Typical alignment is neutral.
Walk 5 ft. and swim 30 ft. Breathe underwater only and hold breath for 1 hour. Darkvision reaches 30 ft. and reads darkness in grayscale. Underwater Stealth checks have advantage.
Slide through gaps as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing. Armor, weapons, and shields are unavailable. The tentacles can still handle most other objects.
Tentacle unarmed strikes deal 1d4 bludgeoning plus the chosen Strength or Dexterity modifier. They qualify as finesse weapons for effects such as Sneak Attack.

Underwater, release a cloud of ink in a 20-ft. radius. It heavily obscures the area for up to 1 minute. Significant current can disperse it early. Immediately afterward you may Dash as a bonus action. Recharges on a short or long rest.
Speaks, reads, and writes Common.
